run_amber_minimization_pipeline: run the amber_minimize pipeline on a protein structure with configurable stiffness and max iterations
test_amber_minimization_with_disulfides: test the amber_minimize pipeline on a protein with multiple disulfide bonds and verify output keys
test_invalid_protein_assertion: test that amber_minimize raises a ValueError when given a protein with residues containing no atoms
run_iterative_relaxation: run the amber_minimize pipeline iteratively to reduce structural violations and lower energy
find_structural_violations: find between-residue connection violations and clash masks for a protein structure using find_violations
